preconditions.description: Attacker must be an authorized address (owner or authorized account) to call performairdrop function
The 'from' address specified in performairdrop must have sufficient MetaApes token balance to cover the total airdrop amount

exploit_hint: As an authorized attacker, call the performairdrop function specifying your own address as the 'from' parameter and an array containing your address as the recipient with a large token amount. This will transfer tokens from the contract or another victim's balance to your address without proper authorization checks, bypassing fee mechanisms since the function calls _tokenTransfer with takeFee=false.
